The '''Mondress sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of the [[galaxy]]. It was located between the [[Kokash sector/Legends|Kokash sector]] and the [[Albanin sector/Legends|Albanin sector]]. It was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' passed through the sector.
